item.title: How to deep clone an object in JavaScript
item.description: Creating complete copies of nested objects is a common requirement when working with complex data structures in JavaScript applications. As the creator of CoreUI, a widely used open-source UI library, I’ve encountered this challenge countless times when managing component state and configuration objects. The most modern and reliable solution is using the structuredClone() method, which creates true deep copies of objects. This method handles nested objects, arrays, and most data types correctly.
